title: An Unconditional Sixth-Energy Saving for Riemann Zeta Zeros and a Local Prime-Window Exceptional-Pair Bound
decided_scope: Unconditional power saving delta = 1/200 for the sixth additive energy E_6(sigma, T) of Riemann zeta zeros on |sigma - 7/8| <= 1/1000 and local exceptional-pair bound V(N,H) << N^(19/15 - 1/10000 + epsilon) near log_N H = 5/12
open_boundaries: Global resolution of the Second Hardy-Littlewood Conjecture pi(x+y) <= pi(x)+pi(y)
